violation_type.title: Notify Parents of Change in Operational Policy or Enrollment Agreement (26 TAC §746.505(2))
violation_type.short_title: Notify Parents of Change in Operational Policy or Enrollment Agreement
violation_type.typical_finding: Operational policies were updated last April 15th, 2025 and enrollment records were reviewed and there was no written documentation in any of the children's admission records of the updated policies with a parent signature acknowledging receipt of the new policies.

finding_variants.text: Operational policies were updated last April 15th, 2025 and enrollment records were reviewed and there was no written documentation in any of the children's admission records of the updated policies with a parent signature acknowledging receipt of the new policies.
The operation had a change in policy regarding the recording of cameras at the operation and did not change required documents provided to parents.
The operation updated the emergency preparedness plan and added the safe policy section to the parent handbook during the monitor visit.

The center dismissed a parent for not signing up for the summer session, but no other parent was asked to sign up for a summer session. The operational policy does not include a separate enrollment for the summer session.

The operation failed to amend their Operational Policy or Enrollment agreement to notify parents of the center's change in operating hours. The current Operational Policy Handbook indicates operating hours are from 6:00am to 6:00pm. After Covid the operation operating hours were from 7:00am to 6:00pm.
Through the course of the investigation it was found the operational policies were updated and notification had not been provided to parents.
